# Copilot Instructions

- Review all pull requests.
- Start reviewing the changes as soon as new commits are added to a pull request.
- Always show a summary of comments made by you that are yet to be resolved.
- Always check: security, performance, accessibility, maintainability.
- Approval criteria: Approve if no high/severe issues and all comments addressed. Request changes if any high/severe issues or >3 medium issues.
- Coverage by PR type: Critical changes require 2+ reviewers and full test coverage. Minor docs/typo PRs may use single reviewer.
- Before approval: Provide explicit summary of any unresolved comments.
- Approve the pull request to indicate your review is complete; leave the actual merge to the repository maintainers.
